# Prepare Data

## Behavioral Data

### QA Data

```{r}
# Read in ONLY the IDs for each assessment of potential interest
bayleyID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/Bayley.csv'))[,1:3]
itseaID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/ITSEA.csv'))[,1:3]
mchatID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/MCHAT.csv'))[,1:3]
vinelandID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/Vineland.csv'))[,1:3]
srsID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/SRS.csv'))[,1:3]
cbclID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/CBCL.csv'))[,1:3]
briefID <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/behavioral/BRIEF.csv'))[,1:3]

# Concatonate IDs into one ID list
allID <- c(bayleyID$study_id,
           itseaID$study_id,
           mchatID$study_id,
           vinelandID$study_id,
           srsID$study_id,
           cbclID$study_id,
           briefID$study_id)
allID <- unique(allID)

# Create a summarized ID frame for each measure
assessmentSummary <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(allID), ncol=10))
colnames(assessmentSummary) <- c('ID','Study','TimePoint',
                                 'Bayley','ITSEA','MCHAT','Vineland','SRS','CBCL','BRIEF')

# Pull IDs, Study, and Time points for each assessment
for(i in 1:length(allID)){
  
  tempID <- allID[i]

  #Bayley
  tempData <- subset(bayleyID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
    assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$Bayley[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$Bayley[i] <- F
  }
  
  #ITSEA
  tempData <- subset(itseaID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
    assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$ITSEA[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$ITSEA[i] <- F
  }
  
  #MCHAT
  tempData <- subset(mchatID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
    assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$MCHAT[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$MCHAT[i] <- F
  }
  
  #Vineland
  tempData <- subset(vinelandID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
    assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$Vineland[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$Vineland[i] <- F
  }
  
  #SRS
  tempData <- subset(srsID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
    assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$SRS[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$SRS[i] <- F
  }
  
  #CBCL
  tempData <- subset(cbclID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
    assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$CBCL[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$CBCL[i] <- F
  }
  
  #BRIEF
  tempData <- subset(briefID, study_id == tempID)
  
  if(nrow(tempData)>0){
    assessmentSummary$ID[i] <- tempData$study_id[1]
    assessmentSummary$Study[i] <- tempData$study [1]
   # assessmentSummary$TimePoint[i] <- tempData$timepoint [1]
    assessmentSummary$BRIEF[i] <- T
  } else {
    assessmentSummary$BRIEF[i] <- F
  }
}

# Write out a high level table verifying IF the test exists by ID
# write.table(assessmentSummary, 'AssessmentSummary.csv',col.names = T, row.names = F, sep=',')
```

## Read Imaging Data

### Anatomical Data

```{r}

testData <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/anatomical/combinedASDData.csv'),stringsAsFactors=F)
testPreemie <- subset(testData, PretermStatus=='Preterm' & (Kidokoro <8 | is.na(Kidokoro)))
testFetal <- subset(testData, PretermStatus=='Term' & CHDStatus !='CHD' & AnyFetal==T)

testFetalPass <- subset(testFetal, mchat_result=='Pass')
testFetalFail <- subset(testFetal, mchat_result=='Fail')

fetalPassID <- vector()
fetalFailID <- vector()


for(i in 1:nrow(testFetalPass)){
  
  tempID <- testFetalPass$study_id[i]
  tempProj <- testFetalPass$study[i]
  
  if(tempProj=='ABC') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_00',tempID)
    fetalPassID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else if(tempProj=='CHD R01') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_0',tempID)
    fetalPassID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else if(tempProj=='Placenta') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('pl_1',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,4,nchar(tempID)))))
    fetalPassID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else {
    tempRescue <- as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))
    if(tempRescue < 100) {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%03d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
      fetalPassID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
    } else {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
      fetalPassID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
    }
  }
}

for(i in 1:nrow(testFetalFail)){
  
  tempID <- testFetalFail$study_id[i]
  tempProj <- testFetalFail$study[i]
  
  if(tempProj=='ABC') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_00',tempID)
    fetalFailID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else if(tempProj=='CHD R01') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_0',tempID)
    fetalFailID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else if(tempProj=='Placenta') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('pl_1',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,4,nchar(tempID)))))
    fetalFailID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else {
    tempRescue <- as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))
    if(tempRescue < 100) {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%03d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
      fetalFailID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
    } else {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
      fetalFailID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
    }
  }
}




tissueDir <- here("data", "anatomical", "tissueVolumes_Individual")
regionalDir <- here("data", "anatomical", "regionalVolumes_Individual")
vermisVol <- read.csv(here("_Earlier_Iteration_NeurodevelopmentalRisk", "data", "anatomicalData", "vermisParcVolumes_071026.csv"), stringsAsFactors=F)
vermisVol$totalVermis <- vermisVol$supVerm + vermisVol$infVerm + vermisVol$midVerm

setwd(tissueDir)
tissueFiles <- list.files()
fetalFailID[!(fetalFailID %in% substr(tissueFiles, 0, nchar(tissueFiles)-19))]

setwd(regionalDir)
regionalFiles <- list.files()
fetalFailID[!(fetalFailID %in% substr(regionalFiles, 0, nchar(regionalFiles)-21))]



anatTimePoints <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=3, nrow=length(fetalFailID)))
colnames(anatTimePoints) <- c('ID','tissueFiles','regionalFiles')
anatTimePoints$ID <- fetalFailID

for(i in 1:nrow(anatTimePoints)){
  targetID <- anatTimePoints$ID[i]
  anatTimePoints$tissueFiles[i] <- sum(substr(tissueFiles, 0, nchar(regionalFiles)-21) %in% targetID)
  anatTimePoints$regionalFiles[i] <- sum(substr(regionalFiles, 0, nchar(regionalFiles)-21) %in% targetID)
}
```

### Anatomical Matching

IMPORTANT NOTE – ORIGINALLY WE MATCHED WITHIN COHORT WHEN POSSIBLE.

TO AVOID ISSUES WITH HIGH RISK PREGNANCIES IN THE PL COHORT THE CODE HAS BEEN WRITTEN TO HARD CODE SOME PARTICIPANT LEVEL SWAPS TO REPLACE THE MCHAT PASSES FROM THE PLACENTA COHORT

```{r}

fetalMchatMelt <- melt(testFetal, measure.vars=c('ScanAge1', 'ScanAge2'), id.vars=c('study_id', 'mchat_result','study'))
fetalMchatMelt <- subset(fetalMchatMelt, mchat_result!='' & value!='')
rownames(fetalMchatMelt) <- 1:nrow(fetalMchatMelt)
colnames(fetalMchatMelt) <- c('study_id','mchat_result','study','scanTimepoint','scanAge')

# fetalMchatMelt <- fetalMchatMelt[!c(fetalMchatMelt$study == 'Placenta' & fetalMchatMelt$mchat_result == 'Pass'),]

# fetalMchatMelt <- subset(fetalMchatMelt, study_id != 'RES-175' | scanTimepoint != 'ScanAge1')
# fetalMchatMelt <- subset(fetalMchatMelt, study_id != 'RES-184' | scanTimepoint != 'ScanAge1')
# fetalMchatMelt <- subset(fetalMchatMelt, study_id != 'RES-2175' | scanTimepoint != 'ScanAge1')

set.seed(1000)
fetalMchatMatch <- matchit(data=fetalMchatMelt, factor(mchat_result, levels=c('Pass','Fail')) ~ scanAge + study)

fetalMatched <- fetalMchatMelt[c(fetalMchatMatch$match.matrix, rownames(!is.na(fetalMchatMatch$match.matrix))[!is.na(fetalMchatMatch$match.matrix)]),]
fetalMatched <- subset(fetalMatched, !is.na(study_id ))

t.test(subset(fetalMatched, mchat_result=='Fail')$scanAge, subset(fetalMatched, mchat_result=='Pass')$scanAge)

fetalMatched$shortID <- NA
for(i in 1:nrow(fetalMatched)){
  
  tempID <- fetalMatched$study_id[i]
  tempProj <- fetalMatched$study[i]
  
  if(tempProj=='ABC') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_00',tempID)
    fetalMatched$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else if(tempProj=='CHD R01') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_0',tempID)
    fetalMatched$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else if(tempProj=='Placenta') {
    tempIDFormat <- paste0('pl_1',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,4,nchar(tempID)))))
    fetalMatched$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat
  } else {
    tempRescue <- as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))
    if(tempRescue < 100) {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%03d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
      fetalMatched$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
    } else {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
      fetalMatched$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
    }
  }
}

fetalMatched$scanTimepoint <- as.character(fetalMatched$scanTimepoint)
fetalMatched$longID <- paste0(fetalMatched$shortID,'_0', substr(fetalMatched$scanTimepoint,nchar(fetalMatched$scanTimepoint),1000))
rownames(fetalMatched) <- fetalMatched$longID


fetalMatched[!(fetalMatched$longID %in% substr(tissueFiles, 0, nchar(tissueFiles)-16)),]
fetalMatched[!(fetalMatched$longID %in% substr(regionalFiles, 0, nchar(regionalFiles)-18)),]

# TRUE or FALSE to turn on the hand matching
HANDMATCH <- T

if(HANDMATCH) {
  
  ## HERE IS THE HAND MATCHING CODE
  #View(subset(fetalMchatMelt, mchat_result=='Pass')[!c(subset(fetalMchatMelt, mchat_result=='Pass')$study_id %in% fetalMatched$study_id),])
  
  # WHEN IN DOUBT CAN GO A LITTLE YOUNGER AND STILL BE IN PARITY
  #pl_10011_01 - 38.571 --- fetus_02151_02 - 38.571 - (F)
  #pl_10027_01 - 38.429 --- fetus_02201_02 - 38.429 - (F)
  #pl_10029_01 - 28.429 --- fetus_02020_01 - 28.286 - (M) | others nearby...
  #pl_10029_02 - 31.571 --- rescue_0142_02 - 31.571 - (F) | others nearby (see pl_10125_01 below)
  #pl_10051_01 - 23.571 --- fetus_00556_01 - 23.710 - (M) | others nearby...
  #pl_10091_01 - 28.286 --- fetus_02172_01 - 28.286 - (M) | others nearby...
  #pl_10106_01 - 35.143 --- fetus_02107_02 - 35.143 - (F) | RES-178_02
  #pl_10124_01 - 26.429 --- fetus_02023_01 - 26.429 - (F) | RES-193_01
  #pl_10125_01 - 35.571 --- fetus_02104_02 - 35.571 - (F) | others nearby...
  
  #fetus_02153_01 - 28.286 (F) --  
  
  #Identify who is to be removed and who is to be added
  removeList <- c('pl_10011_01','pl_10027_01','pl_10029_01','pl_10029_02','pl_10051_01','pl_10091_01','pl_10106_01','pl_10124_01','pl_10125_01','fetus_02153_01')
 
  addListShort <- c('2120', #pl_10011_01 match 1
                    #'2151', #pl_10011_01 match 2
                    
                    '2121', #pl_10027_01 match 1
                    #'2201', #pl_10027_01 match 2
                    
                    '2020',
                    'RES-142',
                    '556',
                    '2172',
                    '2107',
                    
                    'RES-193', #pl_10124_01 match 1
                    #'2023', #pl_10124_01 match 2
                    
                    '2104',
                    'RES-042')
  
  addListFull <- c('fetus_02120_02', #pl_10011_01 match 1
                   #'fetus_02151_02', #pl_10011_01 match 2
                   
                   'fetus_02121_02', #pl_10027_01 match 1
                   #'fetus_02201_02', #pl_10027_01 match 2
                   
                   'fetus_02020_01',
                   'rescue_0142_02',
                   
                   'fetus_00556_01', #pl_10051_01 match 1
                   #'RES-217', #pl_10051_01 match 2
                   #'RES-79', #pl_10051_01 match 3
                   
                   'fetus_02172_01',
                   'fetus_02107_02',
                   
                   'rescue_0193_01', #pl_10124_01 match 1
                   #'fetus_02023_01', #pl_10124_01 match 2
                   
                   'fetus_02104_02',
                   'rescue_0042_01')
  
  #Pull those to be added and format dataframe for merging
  shortAddFrame <- fetalMchatMelt[fetalMchatMelt$study_id %in% addListShort,]
  
  shortAddFrame$shortID <- NA
  for(i in 1:nrow(shortAddFrame)){
    
    tempID <- shortAddFrame$study_id[i]
    tempProj <- shortAddFrame$study[i]
    
    if(tempProj=='ABC') {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_00',tempID)
      shortAddFrame$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat
    } else if(tempProj=='CHD R01') {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('fetus_0',tempID)
      shortAddFrame$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat
    } else if(tempProj=='Placenta') {
      tempIDFormat <- paste0('pl_1',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,4,nchar(tempID)))))
      shortAddFrame$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat
    } else {
      tempRescue <- as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))
      if(tempRescue < 100) {
        tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%03d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
        shortAddFrame$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
      } else {
        tempIDFormat <- paste0('rescue_',sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(substr(tempID,5,nchar(tempID)))))
        shortAddFrame$shortID[i] <- tempIDFormat 
      }
    }
  }
  
  shortAddFrame$scanTimepoint <- as.character(shortAddFrame$scanTimepoint)
  shortAddFrame$longID <- paste0(shortAddFrame$shortID,'_0', substr(shortAddFrame$scanTimepoint,nchar(shortAddFrame$scanTimepoint),1000))
  rownames(shortAddFrame) <- shortAddFrame$longID
  
  shortAddFrame <- shortAddFrame[shortAddFrame$longID %in% addListFull,]

  #Remove the excluded pl participants
  fetalMatched <- fetalMatched[!c(fetalMatched$longID %in% removeList),]
  #Add in the replacements
  fetalMatched <- rbind(fetalMatched, shortAddFrame)
}
```

### Functional Matching

```{r}

#| echo: false

asdDemo <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/functional/asdDemo_expand.csv'), stringsAsFactors = F)
tdDemo <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/functional/tdDemo.csv'), stringsAsFactors = F)

asdDemo <- asdDemo[asdDemo$ID!='rescue_0187_01',] #Why is this excluded? Why are 715,748 included?
rownames(asdDemo) <- 1:nrow(asdDemo)


asdDemo$Grp <- 'ASD'
tdDemo$Grp <- 'TD'
combDemo <- rbind(asdDemo, tdDemo)

matchFrame <- MatchIt::matchit(as.factor(Grp) ~ ScanGA, data=combDemo)

tdDemoMatch <- tdDemo[matchFrame$match.matrix,]
tdDemoMatch <- tdDemoMatch[complete.cases(tdDemoMatch),]
tdDemoMatch <- tdDemoMatch[order(as.numeric(row.names(tdDemoMatch))), ]

dropPtList <- c('none')

keepRows <- as.numeric(rownames(asdDemo[!(asdDemo$ID %in% dropPtList), ]))
tdDemoFinal <- tdDemoMatch[keepRows,]
asdDemoFinal <- asdDemo[keepRows,]


mean(tdDemoFinal$ScanGA)
sd(tdDemoFinal$ScanGA)
mean(asdDemoFinal$ScanGA)
sd(asdDemoFinal$ScanGA)

t.test(tdDemoFinal$ScanGA, asdDemoFinal$ScanGA)


xiSqTable <- matrix(ncol=2, nrow=2)
xiSqTable[1,1] <- nrow(subset(tdDemoFinal, Sex=='m'))
xiSqTable[1,2] <- nrow(subset(tdDemoFinal, Sex=='f'))
xiSqTable[2,1] <- nrow(subset(asdDemoFinal, Sex=='m'))
xiSqTable[2,2] <- nrow(subset(asdDemoFinal, Sex=='f'))
chisq.test(xiSqTable)
```

```{r}
tissueDataRaw <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/anatomical/tissueVolumes_12122025_compiled.csv'))
tissueDataRaw$TBV <- rowSums(tissueDataRaw[,c('CorticalGrayMatter','CorticalWhiteMatter','Cerebellum','SubcorticalGray','Brainstem','AmygdalaHippocampus')], na.rm=T)
tissueData <- tissueDataRaw[,c('longID','CorticalGrayMatter','CorticalWhiteMatter','Cerebellum','SubcorticalGray','Brainstem','AmygdalaHippocampus')]
rownames(tissueData) <- tissueData$longID
tissueData <- subset(tissueData, select = -c(longID))


# Analyze trajectories across tissue ROI
glmTissueVolTable <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=9, nrow=ncol(tissueData)))
colnames(glmTissueVolTable) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','pEta2')

glmTissueVolTable.Itx <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=11, nrow=ncol(tissueData)))
colnames(glmTissueVolTable.Itx) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','Itx.B','Itx.p','pEta2')

glmTissueNormedVolTable <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=9, nrow=ncol(tissueData)))
colnames(glmTissueNormedVolTable) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','pEta2')

glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=11, nrow=ncol(tissueData)))
colnames(glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','Itx.B','Itx.p','pEta2')

for(i in 1:ncol(tissueData)){
  
  tissueVolumeROI <- tissueData[,i, drop=FALSE]
  colnames(tissueVolumeROI) <- 'Volume'
  tissueVolumeROI$Volume <- as.numeric(tissueVolumeROI$Volume)
  
  tempAnalyses <- merge(fetalMatched[,c('shortID','longID','scanAge', 'mchat_result')], tissueVolumeROI, by="row.names")
  tempAnalyses <- tempAnalyses[complete.cases(tempAnalyses),]
  tempAnalyses$mchat_result <- factor(tempAnalyses$mchat_result)
  tempAnalyses$scanAge <- as.numeric(tempAnalyses$scanAge)
  
  tempAnalyses <- tempAnalyses[!(tempAnalyses$longID %in% c('rescue_0175_01', 'fetus_02178_01','rescue_0184_01')),]
  tempAnalyses <- merge(tempAnalyses,tissueDataRaw, by='longID', all.x=T, all.y=F)
  tempAnalyses$VolNormed <- tempAnalyses$Volume/tempAnalyses$TBV
  
  #Raw volume - no interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, Volume ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmTissueVolTable$ROI[i] <- colnames(tissueData)[i]
  glmTissueVolTable$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$Volume)
  glmTissueVolTable$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$Volume)
  glmTissueVolTable$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$Volume)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$Volume)
  glmTissueVolTable$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmTissueVolTable$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmTissueVolTable$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmTissueVolTable$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmTissueVolTable$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, Volume ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial
  
  #Raw volume - interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, Volume ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$ROI[i] <- colnames(tissueData)[i]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$Volume)
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$Volume)
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$Volume)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$Volume)
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$Itx.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,1]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$Itx.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,5]
  glmTissueVolTable.Itx$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, Volume ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial
  
  
  #Normed volume - no interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, VolNormed ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$ROI[i] <- colnames(tissueData)[i]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$VolNormed)
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$VolNormed)
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$VolNormed)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$VolNormed)
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, VolNormed ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial
  
  #Normed volume - interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, VolNormed ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$ROI[i] <- colnames(tissueData)[i]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$VolNormed)
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$VolNormed)
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$VolNormed)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$VolNormed)
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$Itx.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,1]
  glmTissueNormedVolTable.Itx$Itx.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,5]

}
```

```{r}
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$ROI[i] <- colnames(regionalData)[i]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$VolNormed)
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$VolNormed)
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$VolNormed)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$VolNormed)
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$Itx.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,1]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$Itx.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,5]
  glmRegionalNormedVolTable.Itx$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, VolNormed ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial[3]
  
}


glmRegionalVolTable$Grp.p.Adj <- p.adjust(glmRegionalVolTable$Grp.p, method='fdr')
glmRegionalVolTable$scanGA.p.Adj <- p.adjust(glmRegionalVolTable$scanGA.p, method='fdr')

subset(glmRegionalVolTable, Grp.p.Adj < .05)
```

```{r}
tempAnalyses <- merge(tempAnalyses,regionalDataRaw, by='longID', all.x=T, all.y=F)

tempAnalyses<-tempAnalyses[!tempAnalyses$VolNormed==Inf,]

plotSummary <- Rmisc::summarySE(tempAnalyses, measurevar = 'VolNormed', groupvars = 'mchat_result')
plotSummary$mchat_result <- c('High Risk', 'Low Risk')
colnames(plotSummary)[1] <- 'Autism Risk'
plotSummary$`Autism Risk` <- factor(plotSummary$`Autism Risk`, levels = c('Low Risk','High Risk'))

HPC.L.Plot <- ggplot(data=plotSummary, aes(x=`Autism Risk`, y=VolNormed)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,.003), breaks=seq(0,.003,.0005), expand=c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('#9cc5ffaa','#ff8080aa')) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('#0050bf','#a60000')) +
  geom_bar(stat='identity',aes(fill=`Autism Risk`, color=`Autism Risk`), linewidth=2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=VolNormed-se, ymax=VolNormed+se), width=.125, linewidth=2) +
  ylab('Hippocampus (Left) Volume') +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),

        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black', linewidth = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(color = 'black', size = 24, hjust=0.5),
        panel.grid.major.x =  element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color='#cccccc', linewidth = 1),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill='white'),
        legend.position = 'none',
        legend.text = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        legend.title=element_blank())

  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,.003), breaks=seq(0,.003,.0005), expand=c(0,0)) +
```

```{r}
## Fus Right

regionalVolumeROI <- regionalData[,'FusiformAnt_GM_R', drop=FALSE]
colnames(regionalVolumeROI) <- 'Volume'
regionalVolumeROI$Volume <- as.numeric(regionalVolumeROI$Volume)
  
tempAnalyses <- merge(fetalMatched[,c('shortID','longID','scanAge', 'mchat_result')], regionalVolumeROI, by="row.names")
tempAnalyses <- tempAnalyses[complete.cases(tempAnalyses),]
tempAnalyses$mchat_result <- factor(tempAnalyses$mchat_result)
tempAnalyses$scanAge <- as.numeric(tempAnalyses$scanAge)

tempAnalyses <- tempAnalyses[!(tempAnalyses$longID %in% c('rescue_0175_01', 'fetus_02178_01','rescue_0184_01')),]
tempAnalyses <- merge(tempAnalyses,regionalDataRaw, by='longID', all.x=T, all.y=F)
tempAnalyses$VolNormed <- tempAnalyses$Volume/tempAnalyses$TBV
tempAnalyses<-tempAnalyses[!tempAnalyses$VolNormed==Inf,]
meansTable <- emmeans::emmeans(lme(data=tempAnalyses, VolNormed ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')), ~ mchat_result)

meansTablePlot <- summary(meansTable)

colnames(meansTablePlot)[1] <- 'Autism Risk'
meansTablePlot$`Autism Risk` <- factor(ifelse(meansTablePlot$`Autism Risk`=='Fail','High Risk','Low Risk'), levels = c('Low Risk','High Risk'))


FUS.R.Plot <-  ggplot(data=meansTablePlot, aes(x=`Autism Risk`, y=emmean)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,.002), breaks=seq(0,.003,.0005), expand=c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('#a3c0e9','#e09999')) +
  geom_bar(stat='identity',aes(fill=`Autism Risk`), color='#000000', linewidth=2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=.125, linewidth=2) +
  ylab('Fusiform (Right) Volume') +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = 'black', size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color='black', linewidth = 1),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black', linewidth = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(color = 'black', size = 24, hjust=0.5),
        panel.grid.major.x =  element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color='#cccccc', linewidth = 1),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill='white'),
        legend.position = 'none',
        legend.text = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        legend.title=element_blank())
```

```{r}


ctDataRaw <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/anatomical/CT_Ave_Thickness.csv'), header=F)
ctIDList <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/anatomical/CT_SubList.1D'), header=F)
rownames(ctDataRaw) <- substr(ctIDList$V1,0, nchar(ctIDList$V1)-14)
ctROILabel <- read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/anatomical/CTROILabels.txt'), header=F)
colnames(ctDataRaw) <- ctROILabel$V1
ctData <- ctDataRaw[,c(1:70,79:90)]
ctData$GlobalCT <- t(read.csv(paste0(baseDir,'/anatomical/CT_Global_Thickness.csv'), header=F))




# Analyze trajectories across CT ROI

glmCTTable <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=9, nrow=ncol(ctData)-1))
colnames(glmCTTable) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','pEta2')

glmCTTable.Itx <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=11, nrow=ncol(ctData)-1))
colnames(glmCTTable.Itx) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','Itx.B','Itx.p','pEta2')

glmCTNormedTable <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=9, nrow=ncol(ctData)-1))
colnames(glmCTNormedTable) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','pEta2')

glmCTNormedTable.Itx <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=11, nrow=ncol(ctData)-1))
colnames(glmCTNormedTable.Itx) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','TD.ASD.Diff','Grp.B','Grp.p','scanGA.B','scanGA.p','Itx.B','Itx.p','pEta2')



for(i in 1:(ncol(ctData)-1)){
  
  ctVolumeROI <- ctData[,i, drop=FALSE]
  colnames(ctVolumeROI) <- 'CT'
  ctVolumeROI$CT <- as.numeric(ctVolumeROI$CT)
  ctVolumeROI$GlobalCT <- ctData$GlobalCT
  
  tempAnalyses <- merge(fetalMatched[,c('shortID','longID','scanAge', 'mchat_result')], ctVolumeROI, by="row.names")
  tempAnalyses <- tempAnalyses[complete.cases(tempAnalyses),]
  tempAnalyses$mchat_result <- factor(tempAnalyses$mchat_result)
  tempAnalyses$scanAge <- as.numeric(tempAnalyses$scanAge)
  
  tempAnalyses$CTNormed <- tempAnalyses$CT/tempAnalyses$GlobalCT
  
  #Raw CT - no interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, CT ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmCTTable$ROI[i] <- colnames(ctData)[i]
  glmCTTable$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CT)
  glmCTTable$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CT)
  glmCTTable$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CT)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CT)
  glmCTTable$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmCTTable$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmCTTable$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmCTTable$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmCTTable$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, CT ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial
  
  #Raw CT - interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, CT ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmCTTable.Itx$ROI[i] <- colnames(ctData)[i]
  glmCTTable.Itx$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CT)
  glmCTTable.Itx$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CT)
  glmCTTable.Itx$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CT)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CT)
  glmCTTable.Itx$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmCTTable.Itx$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmCTTable.Itx$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmCTTable.Itx$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmCTTable.Itx$Itx.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,1]
  glmCTTable.Itx$Itx.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,5]
  glmCTTable.Itx$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, CT ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial
  
  
  #Normed CT - no interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, CTNormed ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmCTNormedTable$ROI[i] <- colnames(ctData)[i]
  glmCTNormedTable$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CTNormed)
  glmCTNormedTable$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CTNormed)
  glmCTNormedTable$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CTNormed)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CTNormed)
  glmCTNormedTable$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmCTNormedTable$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmCTNormedTable$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmCTNormedTable$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmCTNormedTable$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, CTNormed ~ mchat_result + scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial
  
  #Normed CT - interaction
  tempModel <- lme(data=tempAnalyses, CTNormed ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$ROI[i] <- colnames(ctData)[i]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CTNormed)
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CTNormed)
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$TD.ASD.Diff[i] <- mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Pass')$CTNormed)-mean(subset(tempAnalyses, mchat_result=='Fail')$CTNormed)
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,1]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[2,5]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$scanGA.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,1]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$scanGA.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[3,5]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$Itx.B[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,1]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$Itx.p[i] <- summary(tempModel)$tTable[4,5]
  glmCTNormedTable.Itx$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lme(data=tempAnalyses, CTNormed ~ mchat_result * scanAge, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim')))$Eta2_partial

}


glmCTTable$Grp.p.Adj <- p.adjust(glmCTTable$Grp.p, method='fdr')
glmCTTable$scanGA.p.Adj <- p.adjust(glmCTTable$scanGA.p, method='fdr')
```

# Functional Analyses

## Whole Brain Approach

First step is to just do a whole brain search

Here, let's run all 19,900 ROI-ROI connections

It's more exploratory and FDR will kill us for sure

```{r}

##### WHOLE BRAIN LINEAR MODEL APPROACH #####

fcGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=8, nrow=ncol(tdFC)))
colnames(fcGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p', 'nIncluded')

fcIntxGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=12, nrow=ncol(tdFC)))
colnames(fcIntxGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'ASD.Mean', 'TD.SE', 'ASD.SE','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p', 'Intx.B','Intx.p', 'nIncluded')

for(i in 1:nrow(fcGLM)){
 
  iteration <- paste("Current iteration: ", i," of ", nrow(fcGLM))
  print(iteration) 
  
  tempTD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(tdFC),tdFC[,i]))
  colnames(tempTD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempTD$Grp <- 'TD'
  tempTD <- merge(tempTD, tdDemoFinal)
  
  tempASD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(asdFC),asdFC[,i]))
  colnames(tempASD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempASD$Grp <- 'ASD'
  tempASD <- merge(tempASD, asdDemoFinal)
  
  glmFrame <- rbind(tempTD, tempASD)
  glmFrame$FC <- as.numeric(glmFrame$FC)
  glmFrame$shortID <- substr(glmFrame$ID, 0, nchar(glmFrame$ID)-3)
  
  # As an alternative, include the ones that have a missing here or there
  # Lose three significant connections, but gain two more that are BS to Cun and to FFG
  # glmFrame <- glmFrame[complete.cases(glmFrame),]
  
  if(is.na(sum(glmFrame$FC))) {
    fcGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFC)[i]
    fcIntxGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFC)[i]
    next}
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ as.factor(Grp) + ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  
  fcGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFC)[i]
  fcGLM$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  fcGLM$nIncluded[i] <- nrow(glmFrame)
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ as.factor(Grp) * ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  fcIntxGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFC)[i]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcIntxGLM$TD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempTD$FC)))
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempASD$FC)))
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,5]
  fcIntxGLM$nIncluded[i] <- nrow(glmFrame)
  
}


fcGLM$Grp.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$Grp.p, method='fdr')
fcGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')

#subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.001)
#subset(fcGLM, GA.p <.05)
subset(fcGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05)
#subset(fcGLM, GA.p.adjust <.05)



fcIntxGLM$Grp.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcIntxGLM$Grp.p, method='fdr')
fcIntxGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcIntxGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')
fcIntxGLM$Intx.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcIntxGLM$Intx.p, method='fdr')

#subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p <.001)
#subset(fcGLM, GA.p <.05)
subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05)
#subset(fcGLM, GA.p.adjust <.05)
subset(fcIntxGLM, Intx.p.adjust <.05)
#subset(fcGLM, GA.p.adjust <.05)



SigROIList <- subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05)$ROI
ROIList1 <- vector()
ROIList2 <- vector()
for(i in 1:length(SigROIList)) {
  ROIList1[i] <- strsplit(SigROIList[i], '_')[[1]][1]
  ROIList2[i] <- strsplit(SigROIList[i], '_')[[1]][2]
}

ROIListFull <- c(ROIList1, ROIList2)
# sort(table(ROIListFull))

write.table(subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/WholeBrain_P05FDR.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
```

```{r}
t<-1
for(i in 1:nrow(fullFCList)){
  for(j in 1:nrow(fullFCList)){
    
    print(paste0(i,' - ',j))
    
    chordDiagram.Base$ConnAbbrev[t] <- paste0(fullFCList[i,],'_',fullFCList[j,])
    chordDiagram.Base$ConnFull[t] <- paste0(fullFCList[i,],'.',i,'_',fullFCList[j,],'.',j)
    
    chordDiagram.Base$ToAbbrev[t] <- fullFCList[i,]
    chordDiagram.Base$ToFull[t] <- paste0(fullFCList[i,],'.',i)
    
    chordDiagram.Base$FromAbbrev[t] <- fullFCList[j,]
    chordDiagram.Base$FromFull[t] <- paste0(fullFCList[j,],'.',j)
    
    targetRow <- subset(wholeBrainTable, ROI == paste0(fullFCList[i,],'.',i,'_',fullFCList[j,],'.',j))
    
    if(nrow(targetRow)==1) {
      chordDiagram.Base$MeanDiff[t] <- targetRow$TD.Mean - targetRow$ASD.Mean 
    } else {
      chordDiagram.Base$MeanDiff[t] <- 0
    }
    
    t <- t+1
  }
}

chordDiagram.Base$ASDConn <- as.numeric(chordDiagram.Base$MeanDiff < 0)
chordDiagram.Base$TDConn <- as.numeric(chordDiagram.Base$MeanDiff > 0)
chordDiagram.Base$MeanDiff[is.na(chordDiagram.Base$MeanDiff)] <- 0
chordDiagram.Base$ASDConn[is.na(chordDiagram.Base$ASDConn)] <- 0
chordDiagram.Base$TDConn[is.na(chordDiagram.Base$TDConn)] <- 0

## DESCRIPTIVE FOR REGIONAL CONNECTIVITY

lobeNames <- c('Frontal','Parietal','Temporal','Occipital','Subcortical','Cerebellum','Brainstem')
allConnDesc <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=7, ncol=7, 0))
colnames(allConnDesc) <- lobeNames
rownames(allConnDesc) <-lobeNames
allConnDescSig <- allConnDesc
allConnDescSig.TD <- allConnDesc
allConnDescSig.ASD <- allConnDesc


for(i in 1:nrow(wholeBrainTable)){
  
  targetConn <- wholeBrainTable$ROI[i]
  
  targetROI1 <- strsplit(targetConn,'_',useBytes=T)[[1]][1]
  targetROI2 <- strsplit(targetConn,'_',useBytes=T)[[1]][2]
  
  targetROI1Name <- paste0(strsplit(targetROI1,'.',fixed=T)[[1]][1],'.',strsplit(targetROI1,'.',fixed=T)[[1]][2])
  targetROI2Name <- paste0(strsplit(targetROI2,'.',fixed=T)[[1]][1],'.',strsplit(targetROI2,'.',fixed=T)[[1]][2])
  
  #Need to manually code Brainstem beacause it's not labeled with a L or R
  if(substr(targetROI1Name,0,2)=='BS') {targetROI1Name <- 'BS'}
  if(substr(targetROI2Name,0,2)=='BS') {targetROI2Name <- 'BS'}
  
  abbrevNet <- NetList[NetList$Name_Abrv %in% targetROI1Name,]
  lobe1 <-abbrevNet$Lobe[1]
  abbrevNet <- NetList[NetList$Name_Abrv %in% targetROI2Name,]
  lobe2 <-abbrevNet$Lobe[1]
  
  index1 <- grep(lobe1, lobeNames)
  index2 <- grep(lobe2, lobeNames)
  
  allConnDesc[index1, index2] <- allConnDesc[index1, index2] + 1
  allConnDesc[index2, index1] <- allConnDesc[index2, index1] + 1
  
  # Just include significant for all groups
  
  if(wholeBrainTable$ROI[i] %in% wholeBrainTableFDR$ROI){
   
    targetRow <- wholeBrainTableFDR[wholeBrainTableFDR$ROI %in% wholeBrainTable$ROI[i],]
    
    allConnDescSig[index1, index2] <- allConnDescSig[index1, index2] + 1
    allConnDescSig[index2, index1] <- allConnDescSig[index2, index1] + 1
    
    if(targetRow$TD.Mean > targetRow$ASD.Mean) {
    
    allConnDescSig.TD[index1, index2] <- allConnDescSig.TD[index1, index2] + 1
    allConnDescSig.TD[index2, index1] <- allConnDescSig.TD[index2, index1] + 1
    
    } else {
    
    allConnDescSig.ASD[index1, index2] <- allConnDescSig.ASD[index1, index2] + 1
    allConnDescSig.ASD[index2, index1] <- allConnDescSig.ASD[index2, index1] + 1
      
    }
  }
}


meltTDConn <- allConnDescSig.TD

meltTDConn$ROWNAMES <- rownames(allConnDescSig.TD)
```

## Smaller Network Approach

Here we are subdividing out into smaller networks

This will (A) help with the crazy FDR correction and (B) more pointedly target questions about connectivity within networks such as the CRB

Biggest job, however, is to define the networks in a rigorous way

```{r}
## First -- divide out the connections into an ROI1 and ROI2 table

connROIs <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=2, nrow=ncol(tdFC)))
colnames(connROIs) <- c('ROI1','ROI2')

for(i in 1:nrow(connROIs)){
  tempROI <- colnames(tdFC)[i]
  
  connROIs$ROI1[i] <- strsplit(tempROI,'_')[[1]][1]
  connROIs$ROI2[i] <- strsplit(tempROI,'_')[[1]][2] 
  
}

```

### Cerebellar

```{r}

# Cerebellar ROI in both ROI
ROI1match <- grepl('CRB',connROIs$ROI1)
ROI2match <- grepl('CRB',connROIs$ROI2)
bothROIMatch <- ROI1match & ROI2match

tdFCNetwork <- tdFC[,bothROIMatch]
asdFCNetwork <- asdFC[,bothROIMatch]

fcGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=10, nrow=ncol(tdFCNetwork)))
colnames(fcGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean','TD.SE', 'ASD.Mean','ASD.SE','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p','pEta2')

fcIntxGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=12, nrow=ncol(tdFCNetwork)))
colnames(fcIntxGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'TD.SE', 'ASD.Mean','ASD.SE','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p','Intx.B','Intx.p','pEta2')


for(i in 1:nrow(fcGLM)){
  
  tempTD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(tdFCNetwork),tdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempTD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempTD$Grp <- 'TD'
  tempTD <- merge(tempTD, tdDemoFinal)
  
  tempASD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(asdFCNetwork),asdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempASD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempASD$Grp <- 'ASD'
  tempASD <- merge(tempASD, asdDemoFinal)
  
  glmFrame <- rbind(tempTD, tempASD)
  glmFrame$FC <- as.numeric(glmFrame$FC)
  glmFrame$shortID <- substr(glmFrame$ID, 0, nchar(glmFrame$ID)-3)
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp + ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  fcGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcGLM$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$TD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempTD$FC)))
  fcGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempASD$FC)))
  fcGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  #fcGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) + ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp * ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  adjustMeans <- emmeans(tempGLM,'Grp')
  
  fcIntxGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.Mean[i] <-as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$emmean[2]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.SE[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$SE[2]
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$emmean[1]
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$SE[1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,5]
  # fcIntxGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) * ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
  
}

fcGLM$Grp.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$Grp.p, method='fdr')
fcGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')

# subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.05)
# subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.01)
# subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.001)

subset(fcGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05)
```

```{r}
}

fcIntxGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=12, nrow=ncol(tdFCNetwork)))
colnames(fcIntxGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'TD.SE', 'ASD.Mean','ASD.SE','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p','Intx.B','Intx.p','pEta2')


for(i in 1:nrow(fcGLM)){
  
  tempTD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(tdFCNetwork),tdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempTD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempTD$Grp <- 'TD'
  tempTD <- merge(tempTD, tdDemoFinal)
  
  tempASD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(asdFCNetwork),asdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempASD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempASD$Grp <- 'ASD'
  tempASD <- merge(tempASD, asdDemoFinal)
  
  glmFrame <- rbind(tempTD, tempASD)
  glmFrame$FC <- as.numeric(glmFrame$FC)
  glmFrame$shortID <- substr(glmFrame$ID, 0, nchar(glmFrame$ID)-3)
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp + ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  fcGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcGLM$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$TD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempTD$FC)))
  fcGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempASD$FC)))
  fcGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  #fcGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) + ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp * ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  adjustMeans <- emmeans(tempGLM,'Grp')
  
  fcIntxGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.Mean[i] <-mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcIntxGLM$TD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempTD$FC)))
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <-mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.SE[i] <-sd(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempASD$FC)))
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,5]
  # fcIntxGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) * ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
}

fcGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')
```

```{r}
  tempASD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(asdFCNetwork),asdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempASD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempASD$Grp <- 'ASD'
  tempASD <- merge(tempASD, asdDemoFinal)
  
  glmFrame <- rbind(tempTD, tempASD)
  glmFrame$FC <- as.numeric(glmFrame$FC)
  glmFrame$shortID <- substr(glmFrame$ID, 0, nchar(glmFrame$ID)-3)
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp + ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  fcGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcGLM$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$TD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempTD$FC)))
  fcGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempASD$FC)))
  fcGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  #fcGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) + ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp * ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  adjustMeans <- emmeans(tempGLM,'Grp')
  
  fcIntxGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.Mean[i] <-as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$emmean[2]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.SE[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$SE[2]
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$emmean[1]
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$SE[1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,5]
  # fcIntxGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) * ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
}

fcGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')
```

### Visual

```{r}

roiNumeric <- c(181,174,153,114,149,195,167,105,116,194,197,162,131,186,135,
                72,60,19,52,35,75,25,15,42,30,91,87,98,57)
bothROIMatch <- vector()

for(i in 1:nrow(connROIs)){

  conn1Num <- as.numeric(strsplit(connROIs$ROI1[i],'.',fixed = T)[[1]][3])
  conn2Num <- as.numeric(strsplit(connROIs$ROI2[i],'.',fixed = T)[[1]][3])

  match1 <- conn1Num %in% roiNumeric
  match2 <- conn2Num %in% roiNumeric
  bothROIMatch[i] <- (match1 & match2)
}


tdFCNetwork <- tdFC[,bothROIMatch]
asdFCNetwork <- asdFC[,bothROIMatch]

fcGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=10, nrow=ncol(tdFCNetwork)))
colnames(fcGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean','TD.SE', 'ASD.Mean','ASD.SE','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p','pEta2')

fcIntxGLM <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=12, nrow=ncol(tdFCNetwork)))
colnames(fcIntxGLM) <- c('ROI', 'TD.Mean', 'TD.SE', 'ASD.Mean','ASD.SE','Grp.B','Grp.p','GA.B','GA.p','Intx.B','Intx.p','pEta2')


for(i in 1:nrow(fcGLM)){
  
  tempTD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(tdFCNetwork),tdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempTD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempTD$Grp <- 'TD'
  tempTD <- merge(tempTD, tdDemoFinal)
  
  tempASD <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(asdFCNetwork),asdFCNetwork[,i]))
  colnames(tempASD) <- c('ID','FC')
  tempASD$Grp <- 'ASD'
  tempASD <- merge(tempASD, asdDemoFinal)
  
  glmFrame <- rbind(tempTD, tempASD)
  glmFrame$FC <- as.numeric(glmFrame$FC)
  glmFrame$shortID <- substr(glmFrame$ID, 0, nchar(glmFrame$ID)-3)
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp + ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  fcGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcGLM$TD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$TD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempTD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempTD$FC)))
  fcGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- mean(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)
  fcGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- sd(as.numeric(tempASD$FC), na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(as.numeric(tempASD$FC)))
  fcGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  #fcGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) + ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
  
  tempGLM <- lme(data=glmFrame, FC ~ Grp * ScanGA, random= ~1|factor(shortID), control=lmeControl(msMaxIter=200, tolerance=1e-4, msTol=1e-5, opt='optim'))
  
  adjustMeans <- emmeans(tempGLM,'Grp')
  
  fcIntxGLM$ROI[i] <- colnames(tdFCNetwork)[i]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.Mean[i] <-as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$emmean[2]
  fcIntxGLM$TD.SE[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$SE[2]
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.Mean[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$emmean[1]
  fcIntxGLM$ASD.SE[i] <- as.data.frame(adjustMeans)$SE[1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Grp.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[2,5]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,1]
  fcIntxGLM$GA.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[3,5]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.B[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,1]
  fcIntxGLM$Intx.p[i] <- summary(tempGLM)$tTable[4,5]
  # fcIntxGLM$pEta2[i] <- effectsize::eta_squared(lm(data=glmFrame, `FC` ~ factor(Grp) * ScanGA))$Eta2_partial
  
}

fcGLM$Grp.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$Grp.p, method='fdr')
fcGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')

# subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.05)
# subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.01)
# subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.001)

subset(fcGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05)
#subset(fcGLM, GA.p.adjust <.05)



fcIntxGLM$Grp.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcIntxGLM$Grp.p, method='fdr')
fcIntxGLM$GA.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcIntxGLM$GA.p, method='fdr')
fcIntxGLM$Intx.p.adjust <- p.adjust(fcIntxGLM$Intx.p, method='fdr')

subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05)
subset(fcIntxGLM, Intx.p.adjust <.05)






write.table(fcGLM, paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_WholeTable.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
write.table(subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.05), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_P05.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
write.table(subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.01), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_P01.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
write.table(subset(fcGLM, Grp.p <.001), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_P001.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
write.table(subset(fcGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_P05FDR.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')

write.table(subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.05 | Intx.p.adjust < .05), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_Intx_P05FDR.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
write.table(subset(fcIntxGLM, Grp.p.adjust <.1 | Intx.p.adjust < .1), paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_Intx_P10FDR.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')
write.table(fcIntxGLM, paste0(baseDir,'/functional/output/Visual_Intx_Wholebrain.csv'), col.names=T, row.names=F, sep=',')




ggplot(data=longFCGLM, aes(x=factor(ROI, levels=pValOrder, ordered=is.ordered(T)), y=FC, group=factor(Group))) +
  #scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-.2,1.2), breaks=seq(-2,2,.2), expand=c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('#d88080cc','#8cb0e3cc')) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('#bb0000','#0000bb')) +
  geom_bar(stat='identity', position='dodge', aes(color=Group,fill=Group)) +
  ylab('Connectivity Strength') + xlab('Subcortical Connections') +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = 'black', size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = 'black', size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color='black', linewidth = 1),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black', linewidth = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(color = 'black', size = 24, hjust=0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = 'dark gray'),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = 'dark gray'),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill='white'),
        legend.position = 'none',
        legend.text = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        legend.title=element_blank())
```
